query_text: what temperature can food be accepted at

action.query: FDA Food Code receiving temperature TCS food cold hot frozen shell eggs milk food accepted at temperature
queries: FDA Food Code receiving temperature TCS food cold hot frozen shell eggs milk food accepted at temperature

content.text:
In food service, **accept deliveries only at safe temperatures**:

- **Cold TCS foods:** **41°F (5°C) or lower**
- **Hot TCS foods:** **135°F (57°C) or higher**
- **Raw shell eggs:** received in refrigerated equipment at **45°F (7°C) or lower**
- **Frozen food:** must be **solid frozen** with no signs of thawing/refreezing
- **Milk/shellfish:** may have specific legal receiving temperatures, but must meet the applicable requirement

Also reject food if it shows **temperature abuse**—for example, ice crystals/refreezing on thawed items, leaking packages, or warm cold foods. ([fda.gov](https://www.fda.gov/media/184685/download?utm_source=openai))
